the genotypes BARC-8, BR 8014888, and CS 3031PTA276-4-4 are the most suitable parents for selection to increase protein content, and the genotypes CD 01RR 8384, A7002, and Suprema are the best parents for selection to high oil content.

the genotypes Suprema, CS 3032 PTA 276-3-3, CD 01 RR 8384, and BR 8014888, with high protein content, and the genotypes CD 01 RR8384, Suprema, and A7003, with higher oil contents, are recommended as parents in soybean breeding programs, aiming to increase oil or protein contents.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the genotypes with the best performance for protein and oil contents in the progeny are not the same.
the genotypes with the highest oil or protein contents are not necessarily the best parents for the development of soybean varieties with higher oil or higher protein contents, respectively.
the genotypes with higher mean phenotypic value and greater adaptability to the environments evaluated are the most suitable parents for breeding programs.
